macro_bullets: All eyes on today's Fed rate decision, with traders positioning for a possible hawkish hold.
Big Tech earnings loom (Alphabet, Amazon, Oracle) as AI-debt fears ease and the 'AI trade' comeback drives sentiment.
Oil climbs ~2% as Houthi strikes on Yemen and a Saudi refinery stoke supply fears.
The ongoing Iran war keeps pushing up costs, with airlines pulling fuel hedges and consumer brands flagging fresh price hikes.
UK budget speech from Healey outlines 1.2% growth and reversals on gas charges and cash ISA cuts.
internals_narrative: Risk appetite skewed toward hardware and chips, with Robotics & Hardware +10.8%, Memory +4.2% and Semiconductors +3.5% leading, while Energy (-1.7%) and Consumer Staples (-1.0%) lagged. Standout movers include USAR (+16.7%) and OUST (+10.4%) on the upside versus Boeing (-10.7%) and refiners VLO (-9.2%), MPC (-7.4%) and PSX (-7.0%) on the downside.

ticker_notes.USAR: USA Rare Earth broke ground on a $1.2 billion magnet complex as critical-minerals stocks rallied.
ticker_notes.OUST: Ouster surged after unit Stereolabs unveiled its ZED Box 2 series of AI computers for robots.
ticker_notes.RKLB: Rocket Lab touted a $515M military satellite push, with 8 of 18 spacecraft already in production.
ticker_notes.IREN: IREN closed a $363M equipment funding deal with Wingspire for its AI compute business.
ticker_notes.UPS: UPS soared ~6% on a raised outlook as the CEO pushed back on 'volume solves all problems.'
ticker_notes.GM: GM's Mary Barra called the stock undervalued even after a 16% yearly gain and $20B buyback.
ticker_notes.AMD: AMD rose alongside TSMC, which reportedly hiked AI chip packaging prices 20%.
ticker_notes.BA: Boeing hit a fresh 18-month low after a slew of price-target cuts, though BofA calls the turnaround 'still intact.'
ticker_notes.VLO: Valero fell ~8% as refiners slid together despite strong refining margins.
ticker_notes.MPC: Marathon Petroleum sank ~7% in the broad refiner selloff.
ticker_notes.PSX: Phillips 66 posted record Q3 earnings of $5.6B but fell with the refining group.
ticker_notes.WELL: Welltower slumped despite a $21B buying spree and soaring income, even after a Q3-driven upgrade.
ticker_notes.ACN: Accenture's CEO bought $3 million of stock after shares doubled off June lows.
ticker_notes.CME: CME traded in focus ahead of today's Fed rate decision.
ticker_notes.CHTR: Charter Communications looks 'reasonable' to some as shares slump 85%.
ticker_notes.CL: Colgate-Palmolive's Q3 results are seen as unlikely to materially shift its North America narrative.
ticker_notes.APD: Air Products may still trade at a discount even after a 24% run.
ticker_notes.ABBV: AbbVie is seeking FDA approval for etentamig in multiple myeloma.
ticker_notes.AEP: American Electric Power beat Q3 estimates, expanded its capital plan and raised its growth outlook.
